name: The Mentor
fieldReading: Hold the door open behind you.
bio: The one who brings new people in. Watches the edge of the group for whoever is standing alone, and waves them over.
sceneStory: In the middle of an empty dark field stands a single freestanding door, warm light pouring out around its edges. A figure leans into it holding it wide open, one arm stretched out, waving a hesitant newcomer in from the dark.
assignments: The door was held open for you once.
Be the one who holds it wide, and stays.
tagline: Come in — you were always expected
